skills.name: Public speaking
skills.description: Practice clear structure, confident delivery and strong closing statements.

skills.name: Conflict resolution
skills.description: Learn to respond calmly, identify needs and move conflict toward a concrete next step.

skills.name: Team collaboration
skills.description: Improve daily communication, ownership, handoffs and accountability in a team.

skills.name: Job interview storytelling
skills.description: Use STAR-style examples to explain your experience and value in interviews.

challenges.title: One-minute product pitch
challenges.scenario: You have one minute to present a new learning app to a small group of classmates.
challenges.expectedOutcome: The listener understands the problem, the solution and the next step.

challenges.title: Status update to stakeholders
challenges.scenario: Explain project progress, current risks and what help you need from stakeholders.
challenges.expectedOutcome: Stakeholders understand progress, risk and requested decision.

challenges.title: Teammate misses a deadline
challenges.scenario: A teammate missed an agreed deadline and your work is now blocked. Respond without escalating the conflict.
challenges.expectedOutcome: You acknowledge the issue, ask for context and agree on a concrete recovery plan.

challenges.title: Daily standup update
challenges.scenario: Give a short standup update: what you did, what you will do and where you are blocked.
challenges.expectedOutcome: The team can quickly understand progress and blockers.

challenges.title: Tell me about a challenge
challenges.scenario: Answer an interview question about a difficult challenge you solved.
challenges.expectedOutcome: The answer includes situation, task, action, result and what you learned.

prompts.title: Pitch feedback coach
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a practical communication coach. Give concise, direct and actionable feedback.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Evaluate this one-minute pitch. Score clarity, structure and closing. Answer: {{answer}}
prompts.simulatedAiResponse: Mock AI: focus on a stronger hook, make the problem-solution structure explicit, and finish with one concrete call to action.

prompts.title: Conflict de-escalation coach
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a calm workplace mediator. Help the learner lower tension and move toward agreement.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Review this conflict response. Check tone, empathy, ownership and next step. Answer: {{answer}}
prompts.simulatedAiResponse: Mock AI: acknowledge the impact without blame, ask one open question, then propose a specific recovery step and deadline.

prompts.title: Standup update coach
prompts.systemPrompt: You help teams communicate faster and with less ambiguity.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Review this daily standup update for clarity and blockers. Answer: {{answer}}
prompts.simulatedAiResponse: Mock AI: keep the update short, separate done/today/blockers, and clearly state who you need help from.

prompts.title: STAR interview coach
prompts.systemPrompt: You are an interview coach. Evaluate examples using the STAR method and career relevance.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Evaluate this interview story. Check situation, task, action, result and lesson. Answer: {{answer}}
prompts.simulatedAiResponse: Mock AI: add measurable result, make your personal action clearer, and end with what the experience taught you.
